drills.name: Target Lock
drills.about: One ball turns red, then all of them turn white and scatter. Keep your eyes on the one that was red.

drills.name: Divided Pursuit
drills.about: Two dots trace opposite Lissajous curves. Hold both at once without turning your head.

drills.name: Infinity Pursuit
drills.about: A single dot runs a figure-eight. Follow it with your eyes only.

drills.name: Jump Grid
drills.about: Dots light up one at a time across a grid. Snap your eyes to each the moment it lights.

drills.name: Edge Flash
drills.about: Hold the centre cross while dots flash at the rim. Count them without looking away.

drills.name: Odd One Out
drills.about: A field of circles hides one square. Find it before the ring appears.

drills.name: Constant Slow Pursuit
drills.about: A dot creeps along a visible Lissajous curve. Stay glued to it without blinking ahead.

drills.name: Sine-Wave Pursuit
drills.about: Track a dot oscillating along a horizontal sine wave guide line.

drills.name: Triangular Pursuit
drills.about: Follow the dot around a triangle. The corners are where eyes fall behind.

drills.name: Zig-Zag Path Pursuit
drills.about: Track the dot along a multi-segment zig-zag. Sharp reversals, no warning.

drills.name: Predictive Pursuit
drills.about: The dot slips behind a band and comes out the other side. Your eyes have to guess where.

drills.name: Spatial-Shift Pursuit
drills.about: Track a dot that keeps changing speed on the same path. Rhythm will not save you.

drills.name: Ghosting Suppress Pursuit
drills.about: Trails follow the dot. Lock onto the real one and let the ghosts go.

drills.name: Vertical Tracking
drills.about: Stepped moves: a horizontal slide, then a vertical snap. Follow both.
